title: Diarized meeting/interview transcript (template `transcript`)
description: Contract accepted by functions/delivery/renderers-src/transcript/render.py. The renderer emits transcript.md, transcript.html and transcript.docx from one payload. Exactly one turn source must be present: `turns`, `segments`, or the Azure AI Speech batch shape (`recognizedPhrases`, with `combinedRecognizedPhrases` as the undiarized fallback). Everything else is envelope metadata, all optional, house style applied when absent. The renderer never invents, summarises or corrects speech: `summary`, `actions` and `notes` are written upstream by the agent step and passed through verbatim.

title.description: Document title. Defaults to a house-style title built from supplier/service/date.

supplier.description: Supplier name as used in Reports/<Supplier>/. Placeholder names only in samples.

service.description: Service name as used in Reports/<Supplier>/<Service>/.

locale.description: BCP-47 tag of the spoken language, e.g. 'en-GB', 'pt-PT'.

engine.description: What produced the transcript, e.g. 'Azure AI Speech batch transcription (diarization on)'.

speakerNames.description: Diarization label -> person or role. This is an assertion about who spoke, so it is supplied in the approved contract, never guessed by the renderer (the governed equivalent of the skill's relabel_speakers.py).

summary.description: Written by the agent step, not by the renderer.

notes.description: Processing notes, e.g. that pt-BR normalisation was applied upstream.

recognizedPhrases.description: Shape B — Azure AI Speech v3.2 batch result.

combinedRecognizedPhrases.description: Undiarized fallback used only when recognizedPhrases carries no speaker labels.

speaker.description: Diarization label; mapped to a person through speakerNames.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the recording.
